title: Run admission and target occupancy
summary: Source and containment preparation precede bounded item/run locks; locked validation rereads mutable facts and reuses only identical repository answers. Occupancy shares QA facts within one evaluation and stops at its first blocker. Item QA followed by gates and final auto completion permits takeover; execution work, different flow/target, missing containment or another live driver prevents it. Refusals name the actual facts; recreating alone is not recovery. Structured run reads preserve complete preparation receipts, including shell pipes in member instructions, for exact-request recovery after response loss. Create reads intake and snapshot inputs in sets within each enrollment, locks requirements and plans in ID order, and discards mutable inputs before the next composition pass. Canonical member validation and atomic takeover remain authoritative. Each read-only orphan check shares peer QA facts only until that check returns, before retraction and the next membership deletion; the outer schema/source cache cannot substitute for this fresh scope. Existing timing records distinguish provisional composition, locked composition, enrollment, commit and response reads; aggregate durations do not prove an individual loop caused latency.
